blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The landmarks inside the University of Santo Tomas (UST) in Sampaloc, Manila were lit in red on Monday, Sept. 21, as an expression of solidarity with the victims and survivors of human rights violations in the Philippines. “May this light bear witness to stories that must not be forgotten, to voices that must not be silenced, and to lives whose dignity must always be upheld,” the UST Simbahayan Community Development Office (CDO) said on Facebook. The lights remained lit until 9 p.m. and will once again illuminate on Tuesday, Sept. 22, from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. READ: […]...
